It may often appear, that the Order for a summary
reference to the Master may on the coming in of the
answer, or upon view of other circumstances, appear to be
erroneous. It may happen that evidence is necessary to
be taken before the hearing, in furtherance of justice. In
such cases, and others, it would be injurious to hold the
Order made, as final. The following Order then pro-
